about_the_game:
These three magic girls just wanted to have fun, but a supernatural mystery will lead to an investigation full of riddles.

In Sunny Trails three goddesses come to Brazil for a party with deities from all around the world, which is to take place on a charming beach that harbors many secrets.

Play as Amaterasu, Goddess of the Sun and lead character, and go on a adventure to unravel a baffling mystery: the girls arrive and find everything ready for a party, but the hosts and guests all seem to be gone.




EXPLORATION
Explore adorable scenery, investigate, go fish, eat yummy food, battle evil minions and dive head first into the story and mysteries that surround this magical island. Help old friends, while you make new and eccentric friendships and find out more about this mystifying place.

BATTLE
Weigh each move carefully before striking. Battles are turn-based and your adversaries might hit you with devastating blows, so plan accordingly for an exciting duel.



Delve into an adorable world full of delightful details for exploration, in the perfect game for anyone looking for both adventure and a cozy, relaxing time.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-2500 3.3GHz/AMD FX-8150 3.6GHz or better
  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 650/Radeon HD 7750 or better
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system

short_description: It was supposed to be a great party, but when Amaterasu and her sisters arrive, they find everything abandoned and all guests turned into stone. Go on an adventure in this cozy turn-based RPG to solve this mystery and save your friends!
